decisions.reason: As a two-component resin injection unit, it builds directly on the firm's established plural-component, pumping and fluid-handling knowledge, so management is likely to retain it and refine it rather than exit quickly.
This product is also closely related to the firm's core engineering and customer applications, which gives the firm enough absorptive capacity to interpret early market feedback and improve it.
An automatic airless spray gun fits squarely within the firm's long-standing spray application capabilities and service network, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
A manual airless spray gun is highly consistent with the firm's existing product family and installed customer base, so it is likely to remain in the portfolio.
Because this air-assisted airless spray gun is a multi-model product line in a core technology area, the firm has strong scope to learn from use cases and sustain it commercially.

The data logger is related to coating equipment but is more peripheral to the firm's traditional mechanical strengths, and its reduced website prominence suggests weaker traction and lower confidence in further commercialization.
